---
title: "Descriptive multivariate seed association"
output: rmarkdown::html_vignette
vignette: >
  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Descriptive multivariate seed association}
  %\VignetteEngine{knitr::rmarkdown}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---

`seed_ppi_mcca()` computes descriptive regularized partial canonical
associations between a seed set and local task-interaction blocks. The current
implementation supports the hemodynamic domain; neural-domain and CCA
inference options are rejected. The result is not a calibrated p-value or a
causal connectivity estimate. Seed-neighborhood overlap is an additional
interpretation limitation.

```{r}
library(multiPPI)
set.seed(123)
n <- 80L
Y <- matrix(rnorm(n * 30), nrow = n)
X <- cbind(intercept = 1, task = rnorm(n))
neighborhoods <- list(6:10, 11:15, 16:20)
result <- seed_ppi_mcca(Y, seed = 1:5, design = X,
                        neighborhoods = neighborhoods, tr = 1,
                        domain = "hemo", prewhiten = FALSE,
                        pca = list(seed_k = 3, light_k = 3, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE),
                        reg = list(l2_x = 0.1, l2_y = 0.1),
                        inference = list(method = "none"))
result$stat
```

Prewhitening and imaging adapters have their own supported-input restrictions.
Changing dimensions, ridge penalties, neighborhood selection, or whitening
changes the descriptive analysis; uncertainty from those decisions is not
quantified by this example.
